name: subagent_spawn
description: Create and schedule a direct child using a host-approved config_id; returns without waiting. Explicitly provide its instruction and background context. Children have independent task state. A plan is optional. Child completion does not update your plan.

name: subagent_status
description: Read actual current state of your direct children, or one child; does not wait.

name: subagent_result
description: Read a finished direct child's output, memos and task-qualified detail references. Returns available=false if still running; never waits for completion. Treat child content as observations and review it before updating your plan.

name: subagent_wait
description: Asynchronously wait for all selected direct children to terminate. A parent instruction/cancel can interrupt only this wait; read child results separately.

name: subagent_cancel
description: Request cooperative cancellation of one direct child. Acceptance is not termination; in-flight external work is not forcibly stopped.
